title: Density-Ratio Losses for Post-Hoc Learning to Defer
abstract: arXiv:2605.19557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study post-hoc Learning to Defer (L2D) through the lens of ideal distributions: divergence-regularized reweightings of the data distribution under which a model attains low task loss. We define deferral via the density-ratio between a model's and an expert's ideals. Using the reduction from density-ratio estimation to class-probability estimation, we derive the DR CPE losses for post-hoc L2D scorers. Deferral decisions are then made by thresholding the scorer. For KL-based ideal distributions, our deferral rule recovers Chow's rule under the original distribution and a connection to an expert-tilted Bayes posterior---which incorporates the expert's performance---depending on if the ideal distributions are marginal or joint distributions. translated_title: 用于事后学习延后的密度比损失
translated_abstract: 我们通过理想分布的视角研究事后学习延后：理想分布是指数据分布在发散度正则化下的重加权，使得模型在该分布下能取得较低的任务损失。我们通过模型理想与专家理想之间的密度比来定义延后。利用从密度比估计到类概率估计的归约，我们推导出适用于事后 L2D 评分器的 DR CPE 损失。延后决策随后通过对评分器进行阈值化来做出。对于基于 KL 散度的理想分布，我们的延后规则在原始分布下可恢复 Chow 规则，并且（取决于理想分布是边缘分布还是联合分布）与专家倾斜的贝叶斯后验——其中纳入了专家的表现——建立起联系。这导出了 DR CPE 损失的两种变体，其中联合变体在实践中计算上更为便利。当……时，我们建立了联合 DR CPE 损失的一致性性质。
tldr: 该论文提出用模型与专家理想分布之间的密度比来定义事后学习延后，推导出两种 DR CPE 损失用于训练延后评分器，其中联合变体在 KL 散度情形下与 Chow 规则及专家倾斜的贝叶斯后验相联系且计算便利。
en_tdlr: This paper defines post-hoc learning to defer via density ratios between model and expert ideal distributions, deriving DR CPE losses that recover Chow's rule and connect to expert-tilted Bayes posteriors, with the joint variant being computationally convenient.
